source: ZXNAME0000XZ is another line of work on extremely low-bit KV-cache quantization for long-context inference. It studies quantization-aware choices such as per-channel key handling, non-uniform quantization, outlier treatment, and optimized kernels.
zh: ZXNAME0000XZ 是用于长上下文推理的极低位 KV 缓存量化的另一项工作。它研究量化感知选择，例如每通道密钥处理、非均匀量化、异常值处理和优化内核。
